checked_profile.summary: Auto coverage with online, phone and local-agent quote options.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Coverage choices
facts.text: Allstate lists liability, collision, comprehensive, and uninsured or underinsured motorist coverage. Limits and required coverage depend on the state.

facts.label: Discount choices
facts.text: Listed savings categories include bundling, students, vehicle safety equipment, and paying in full. Eligibility and savings depend on the policy.

facts.label: Shopping and claims
facts.text: Quotes are available online, by phone or through local agents. Allstate advertises 24/7 claims support; that is not a promise of a claim settlement deadline.
